name: diecast
title: Diecast
description: A model kit's sprue on its instruction sheet: the products are bubblegum-pink plastic parts held by short gates to one runner frame, each beside a numbered tab, lettered black on a white sheet, and a sold-out part is snipped off to a dashed outline.

tokens.--font-round: rounded face of the numerals: prices, number tabs, step numbers, the phone number, the shop's name
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of the small capital labels: menu, categories, status, card headings
tokens.--price-size: price size on a part; the product page scales it up
tokens.--color-bg: page background and the holes in the sprue
tokens.--color-text: text, headings, links, the dashed outline of a sold-out part and the focus ring round a part
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, the footer, the word beside the phone number in the masthead
tokens.--color-line: the heavy rules: under the masthead, round the how-to-order box, above the footer
tokens.--color-hair: thin rules: between opening hours, table rows and news items
tokens.--color-plastic: the kit plastic: runner, gates, tabs, parts, the name plate, the phone and e-mail plates, the quote bar
tokens.--color-box: solid label boxes: step numbers, shop card headings, the current menu item, the sold-out label
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--runner: thickness of the runner frame; also the bar beside a quote
tokens.--gate: thickness of the gates that hold a part to the runner
tokens.--gap: space between runner and part at the sides and bottom: the length of those gates
tokens.--tab: space between the top runner and a part: the top gates and the drop of the number tab
tokens.--cell-min: narrowest a part's cell may be before the sprue drops a column
tokens.--radius: the small corner rounding: parts, runner corners, tabs, code
tokens.--radius-big: the large rounding that gives each part its own outline, and the name plate its round end
tokens.--rule: thickness of the heavy rules and of the dashed outline of a sold-out part
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between phone and e-mail plates, in table cells
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and the padding of boxes
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the how-to-order box
